analysis.executive_summary: Garden.io documentation spans 717 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage across 752 discovered URLs. The site contains 16 confirmed broken internal links, all within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage stands at 51.92% across 313 detected API pages, indicating incomplete usage documentation. Example code reliability scored 0%, flagged as a likely detection limitation due to JavaScript-rendered code blocks. SEO/geo issues affect 32.43% of pages, and 38 links remain unverified due to authentication or rate-limiting barriers.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (717 of 717 pages within scope)
High freshness coverage with 93.44% of pages showing last-updated metadata
API pages successfully detected (313 pages) with 85% detection confidence
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
risks: 16 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation degrade navigation and user trust
API reference coverage at 51.92% leaves nearly half of API surfaces without adequate usage documentation
SEO/geo issue rate of 32.43% may significantly impact discoverability and search rankings
38 unverified links create uncertainty around external resource availability and partnership integrations
Example reliability at 0% suggests code samples may not render or validate correctly for users
Overall confidence score of 63.5% indicates moderate reliability concerns across multiple audit dimensions
Links confidence at 25% signals substantial uncertainty in link health assessment

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 16 confirmed broken internal links to restore documentation navigation integrity
Expand API usage documentation to cover the missing 48% of detected API surfaces with examples and integration guides
Investigate and resolve example code rendering issues (0% reliability likely due to JS-rendered blocks)
Remediate SEO/geo issues affecting 32.43% of pages to improve search visibility and global reach
Audit and resolve 38 unverified links by addressing authentication requirements or replacing inaccessible resources

limitations: Example reliability score of 0% likely reflects detection limitations with JavaScript-rendered code blocks rather than actual content absence
38 unverified links could not be validated due to authentication, rate-limiting, or server blocks; actual availability unknown
External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical content, code functionality, or alignment with current product versions
SEO/geo issue detection does not assess content quality, localization accuracy, or cultural appropriateness
API coverage measurement depends on automated detection patterns and may miss non-standard API documentation structures
